g1he1h0790.name: Heaven Farm
tagA: A Private Realm of Elegance & Serenity
Where Timeless Luxury Meets Boundless Comfort
tagB: 6-BHK Manor with Private Pool, Gazebo & Jacuzzis
g1he1h0790.hero: Heaven Farm luxury villa swimming pool
g1he1h0790.summary: Pet-friendly 6-BHK manor in Gurugram, Delhi NCR featuring private pool, gazebo, indoor bar, jacuzzis, garden, and multiple indoor/outdoor spaces. Accommodates up to 18 guests with 6 bedrooms, 6 beds, and 7 bathrooms.

spaces.name: The Beaumont Lounge
spaces.desc: This expansive 1,200 sq. ft. ground-floor living room features elegant contemporary interiors with high ceilings, warm neutral décor and abundant natural light. Designed for comfort and entertaining, it offers spacious seating for up to 12 guests with a large sectional sofa and plush accent chairs, along with 4 AC units, a 75-inch Smart TV, and a premium music system. Expansive arched windows, a designer chandelier, ambient recessed lighting, textured feature walls, stylish centre tables, soft area rugs, and a nearby powder room complete this inviting space.
spaces.target: The Beaumont Lounge luxury living room

spaces.name: The Sandstone Manor
spaces.desc: This spacious 350 sq. ft. lounge features elegant contemporary interiors with high ceilings, minimalist décor and abundant natural light. Designed for relaxation, it offers comfortable seating for up to 8 guests with plush sofas and accent armchairs, along with an AC for added comfort. Expansive arched floor-to-ceiling windows, sheer curtains, a designer chandelier, recessed lighting, stylish centre table, soft area rug and curated décor create a bright, sophisticated ambience. A nearby powder room adds to the convenience.
spaces.target: The Sandstone Manor lounge arched windows

spaces.name: The Cask
spaces.desc: This elegant ground-floor indoor bar features a stone-finished counter with stylish upholstered bar chairs, creating the perfect space to unwind over drinks and conversations. Contemporary interiors, sophisticated neutral-toned décor, designer display shelving, and warm ambient lighting enhance its inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal social gathering spot.
spaces.target: The Cask luxury indoor bar counter

spaces.name: Oak Chamber
spaces.desc: This elegant ground-floor dining area features a contemporary dining table with plush upholstered chairs, comfortably seating up to 8 guests. Expansive arched windows frame serene garden views and fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting setting for memorable meals.
spaces.target: Oak Chamber elegant villa dining room

spaces.name: Botanica Studio
spaces.desc: The open-plan kitchen on the ground floor is fully equipped for a seamless self-catering experience. It features a gas cooktop, double-door refrigerator, toaster, mixer-grinder, water purifier, electric kettle, along with crockery, cutlery and other premium kitchen essentials, making meal preparation both convenient and enjoyable.
notes: Guests have access to basic reheating only
An on-call chef is available with an in-house curated menu
Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisine can be enjoyed throughout your stay
spaces.target: Botanica Studio gourmet luxury kitchen

spaces.name: Leisure Club
spaces.desc: The first-floor recreational area offers a spacious open-plan setting with a full-sized pool table, perfect for friendly games and gatherings. High ceilings, large arched windows, and scenic outdoor views create a bright and airy ambience, while comfortable lounge chairs and elegant pendant lighting make it an inviting space to relax and unwind.
spaces.target: Leisure Club pool table entertainment lounge

spaces.name: Wicker Deck
spaces.desc: This elegant alfresco terrace offers a spacious open-air setting with comfortable wicker lounge chairs and a central coffee table. Overlooking the pool and lush gardens, it provides a serene backdrop for morning coffee, evening drinks, or intimate conversations in a peaceful outdoor ambience.
spaces.target: Wicker Deck alfresco terrace sunset lounge

spaces.name: Bluewater Retreat
spaces.desc: The private outdoor pool, spanning approximately 250 sq. ft. with a depth of 4.5 ft., offers a refreshing retreat amidst landscaped gardens and open green views. It features a dedicated jacuzzi section, comfortable poolside loungers for relaxation, an outdoor shower, and a spacious pool deck that's perfect for lounging, unwinding, or gathering with friends and family.
spaces.target: Bluewater Retreat villa swimming pool jacuzzi

spaces.name: Meadow Grounds
spaces.desc: The expansive 40,000 sq. ft. landscaped lawn offers a picturesque outdoor setting for relaxation and celebrations. With seating for up to 18 guests, a charming gazebo, an outdoor bar, a children's play area, and outdoor sports facilities, it provides the perfect space for gatherings, special occasions, and memorable experiences amidst lush greenery.
spaces.target: Meadow Grounds expansive villa green lawn

spaces.name: Twilight Pavilion
spaces.desc: This covered outdoor sit-out features a warm wooden pavilion design with a high timber ceiling, stylish pendant lights, and a ceiling fan for added comfort. Comfortable lounge seating with a coffee table, an open-sided layout overlooking the lush lawn, and abundant natural light create a spacious alfresco setting, perfect for relaxing amidst a peaceful green landscape.
spaces.target: Twilight Pavilion wooden garden gazebo

spaces.name: Horizon Patio
spaces.desc: This cosy outdoor sit-out features comfortable wicker lounge seating with an intimate coffee table, making it the perfect spot for tea, coffee, or relaxed conversations. Framed by an elegant arched façade, it overlooks the beautifully landscaped surroundings and offers a seamless indoor-outdoor connection through large glass windows and flowing curtains.
spaces.target: Horizon Patio arched wicker sitout

suites.name: Serene Jacuzzi Suite
suites.desc: 180 sq. ft. first-floor bedroom features warm minimalist interiors and a private balcony overlooking the garden. It offers a queen-sized bed with plush bedding, an ensuite bathroom, AC, ceiling fan and heater for year-round comfort. Large arched windows bring in ample natural light, while a cosy lounge seating area, spacious wardrobe, elegant lighting and contemporary décor create a comfortable and relaxing retreat.
suites.target: Serene Jacuzzi Suite master bedroom

bath.name: Ensuite Spa Jacuzzi Bathroom
bath.desc: Spa-inspired ensuite bathroom is designed for a luxurious experience, featuring a jacuzzi bathtub, walk-in shower and elegant natural stone interiors with designer stone walls. It also includes a dedicated dressing space, premium bath essentials, a hair dryer, a Western commode with bidet, and modern conveniences such as a geyser, fan and exhaust for a comfortable stay.
bath.target: Spa bathroom jacuzzi bathtub stone vanity

suites.name: Stillwater Spa Suite
suites.view: Private balcony with forest & pool views
suites.desc: 180 sq. ft. first-floor bedroom offers a spacious suite-style layout with warm neutral interiors and sophisticated décor. It features a queen-sized bed, ensuite bathroom, 55-inch TV, AC, ceiling fan, heater, and a spacious wardrobe with hangers. Ambient cove lighting, designer pendant lights, and large arched openings create a bright, airy ambience, while the private balcony overlooks serene forest and pool views.
suites.target: Stillwater Spa Suite bedroom

extra.name: Moonstone Lounge (Suite 2 Private Living)
extra.desc: First-floor living lounge with plush sofas, central coffee table, ambient lighting, and large arched windows offering abundant natural light.

bath.name: Ensuite Twin Vanity Spa Bathroom
bath.desc: Spa-inspired ensuite bathroom is designed for a luxurious bathing experience, featuring a private jacuzzi, a spacious glass-enclosed rain shower, and elegant designer tiles with warm ambient lighting. It also includes a separate dressing area, twin countertop wash basins with a wooden vanity, premium brass fixtures, modern sanitaryware, premium bath essentials, a hair dryer, a Western commode with bidet, and conveniences such as a geyser, fan, and exhaust.
bath.target: Bathroom twin vanity jacuzzi glass rain shower

suites.name: Halo Suite
suites.desc: Spacious 380 sq. ft. first-floor bedroom blends Mediterranean-inspired architecture with elegant contemporary interiors, warm neutral tones and curated décor accents. It features a king-sized bed, AC, ceiling fan, heater, dedicated work desk and a wardrobe with hangers. Floor-to-ceiling arched windows fill the room with natural light, while a cosy lounge seating area, designer pendant lighting, handcrafted feature wall, premium finishes and a private balcony with outdoor seating overlooking serene garden views create a refined resort-style retreat.
suites.target: Halo Suite Mediterranean king bedroom

bath.name: Ensuite Glass Rain Shower Bathroom
bath.desc: The contemporary ensuite bathroom is thoughtfully designed with elegant finishes and abundant natural light from a large arched window. It features a glass-enclosed shower, floating vanity with a countertop wash basin, woven-framed mirror with warm ambient lighting, premium brass fixtures and modern sanitaryware. Guests are also provided with premium bath essentials, a hair dryer, a Western commode with bidet, and conveniences such as a geyser, fan and exhaust.
bath.target: Ensuite glass shower floating vanity mirror

suites.name: Morning Mist
suites.desc: 180 sq. ft. first-floor bedroom features contemporary interiors with warm neutral tones and an airy, open layout filled with natural light. It offers a queen-sized bed with plush bedding and an upholstered headboard, an ensuite bathroom, AC, ceiling fan, heater, and a spacious wardrobe with hangers. Designer pendant lights, recessed ceiling lighting, a dedicated vanity area, upholstered bench seating, a soft area rug, and a private balcony overlooking serene forest and pool views complete the space.
suites.target: Morning Mist queen bedroom balcony view

bath.name: Ensuite Double Vanity Bathroom
bath.desc: The contemporary ensuite bathroom is elegantly designed with a double vanity featuring dual wash basins, an elegant stone countertop with floating cabinetry, plush vanity seating, and backlit designer mirrors with warm ambient lighting. It also includes premium brass fixtures, modern sanitaryware, premium bath essentials, a hair dryer, a Western commode with bidet, and conveniences such as a geyser, fan, and exhaust for a comfortable stay.
bath.target: Double vanity bathroom backlit mirrors dual basins

suites.name: Cloud Nine
suites.view: Direct garden views through floor-to-ceiling glass
suites.desc: Spacious 380 sq. ft. ground-floor bedroom features elegant contemporary interiors with warm earthy tones, premium furnishings and refined finishes. It offers a king-sized four-poster bed, 55-inch TV, AC, ceiling fan, heater, dedicated work desk, and a spacious wardrobe with hangers. Large windows and floor-to-ceiling glass doors fill the room with natural light and serene garden views, while exposed wooden beams, wooden flooring, a cosy lounge seating area, and minimalist décor create a bright, airy and luxurious retreat.
suites.target: Cloud Nine four poster bed bedroom luxury

bath.name: Ensuite Stone Vanity Bathroom
bath.desc: The contemporary ensuite bathroom is thoughtfully designed with a spacious walk-in rain shower enclosed by glass, an elegant stone vanity with a countertop wash basin, and a framed designer mirror with warm ambient lighting. A large arched window fills the space with natural light, while premium brass fixtures and modern sanitaryware enhance its refined appeal. Guests are also provided with premium bath essentials, a hair dryer, a Western commode with bidet, and conveniences such as a geyser, fan, and exhaust.
bath.target: Walk-in rain shower stone vanity brass fixtures

suites.name: Soft Dawn
suites.desc: This elegant 180 sq. ft. ground-floor bedroom features warm neutral interiors, minimalist décor and a spacious, light-filled layout. It offers a queen-sized bed, wall-mounted TV, ensuite bathroom, AC, ceiling fan, heater, and a spacious wardrobe with hangers. Large floor-to-ceiling windows and sliding glass doors open to a private balcony overlooking serene garden views, while a cosy window-side seating area, wooden flooring, soft area rugs, designer pendant lighting and refined décor create a peaceful resort-style retreat.
suites.target: Soft Dawn queen bedroom ground floor garden

bath.name: Ensuite Minimalist Rain Shower Bathroom
bath.desc: The contemporary ensuite bathroom is elegantly designed with minimalist interiors and refined natural finishes. It features a spacious walk-in rain shower, an elegant stone vanity with an integrated wash basin, and a designer woven-framed mirror illuminated by warm wall sconces. Premium brass fixtures and modern sanitaryware enhance the space, while a Western commode with bidet, hair dryer, geyser, fan, and exhaust ensure a comfortable and convenient stay.
bath.target: Minimalist rain shower stone vanity wall sconce

heaven-farm-pet-friendly-6-bhk.hero: Heaven Farm luxury villa swimming pool
heaven-farm-pet-friendly-6-bhk.summary: Pet-friendly 6-BHK manor in Gurugram, Delhi NCR featuring private pool, gazebo, indoor bar, jacuzzis, garden, and multiple indoor/outdoor spaces. Accommodates up to 18 guests with 6 bedrooms, 6 beds, and 7 bathrooms.

spaces.name: The Beaumont Lounge
spaces.desc: This expansive 1,200 sq. ft. ground-floor living room features elegant contemporary interiors with high ceilings, warm neutral décor and abundant natural light. Designed for comfort and entertaining, it offers spacious seating for up to 12 guests with a large sectional sofa and plush accent chairs, along with 4 AC units, a 75-inch Smart TV, and a premium music system. Expansive arched windows, a designer chandelier, ambient recessed lighting, textured feature walls, stylish centre tables, soft area rugs, and a nearby powder room complete this inviting space.
spaces.target: The Beaumont Lounge luxury living room

spaces.name: The Sandstone Manor
spaces.desc: This spacious 350 sq. ft. lounge features elegant contemporary interiors with high ceilings, minimalist décor and abundant natural light. Designed for relaxation, it offers comfortable seating for up to 8 guests with plush sofas and accent armchairs, along with an AC for added comfort. Expansive arched floor-to-ceiling windows, sheer curtains, a designer chandelier, recessed lighting, stylish centre table, soft area rug and curated décor create a bright, sophisticated ambience. A nearby powder room adds to the convenience.
spaces.target: The Sandstone Manor lounge arched windows

spaces.name: The Cask
spaces.desc: This elegant ground-floor indoor bar features a stone-finished counter with stylish upholstered bar chairs, creating the perfect space to unwind over drinks and conversations. Contemporary interiors, sophisticated neutral-toned décor, designer display shelving, and warm ambient lighting enhance its inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal social gathering spot.
spaces.target: The Cask luxury indoor bar counter

spaces.name: Oak Chamber
spaces.desc: This elegant ground-floor dining area features a contemporary dining table with plush upholstered chairs, comfortably seating up to 8 guests. Expansive arched windows frame serene garden views and fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting setting for memorable meals.
spaces.target: Oak Chamber elegant villa dining room

spaces.name: Botanica Studio
spaces.desc: The open-plan kitchen on the ground floor is fully equipped for a seamless self-catering experience. It features a gas cooktop, double-door refrigerator, toaster, mixer-grinder, water purifier, electric kettle, along with crockery, cutlery and other premium kitchen essentials, making meal preparation both convenient and enjoyable.
notes: Guests have access to basic reheating only
An on-call chef is available with an in-house curated menu
Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisine can be enjoyed throughout your stay
spaces.target: Botanica Studio gourmet luxury kitchen

spaces.name: Leisure Club
spaces.desc: The first-floor recreational area offers a spacious open-plan setting with a full-sized pool table, perfect for friendly games and gatherings. High ceilings, large arched windows, and scenic outdoor views create a bright and airy ambience, while comfortable lounge chairs and elegant pendant lighting make it an inviting space to relax and unwind.
spaces.target: Leisure Club pool table entertainment lounge

spaces.name: Wicker Deck
spaces.desc: This elegant alfresco terrace offers a spacious open-air setting with comfortable wicker lounge chairs and a central coffee table. Overlooking the pool and lush gardens, it provides a serene backdrop for morning coffee, evening drinks, or intimate conversations in a peaceful outdoor ambience.
spaces.target: Wicker Deck alfresco terrace sunset lounge

spaces.name: Bluewater Retreat
spaces.desc: The private outdoor pool, spanning approximately 250 sq. ft. with a depth of 4.5 ft., offers a refreshing retreat amidst landscaped gardens and open green views. It features a dedicated jacuzzi section, comfortable poolside loungers for relaxation, an outdoor shower, and a spacious pool deck that's perfect for lounging, unwinding, or gathering with friends and family.
spaces.target: Bluewater Retreat villa swimming pool jacuzzi

spaces.name: Meadow Grounds
spaces.desc: The expansive 40,000 sq. ft. landscaped lawn offers a picturesque outdoor setting for relaxation and celebrations. With seating for up to 18 guests, a charming gazebo, an outdoor bar, a children's play area, and outdoor sports facilities, it provides the perfect space for gatherings, special occasions, and memorable experiences amidst lush greenery.
